title: From Template to Production
subtitle: Vibe-code from a template in any tool, deploy through Blaze, and let Blaze own compliance — end to end.

scenes.narration: From template to production. Vibe-code from a template in any tool, deploy through Blaze, and let Blaze own compliance end to end.

beats.text: From Template to Production
Build in any tool → deploy through Blaze → compliance, handled.
~3 minutes

scenes.narration: Three moves hold the whole story together. Start from a template and vibe-code your app in whatever tool you like. Deploy it through Blaze, our enterprise Vercel. And Blaze owns one hundred percent of compliance — including the manual steps — telling you exactly where your deployment stands.

beats.text: The story, in three moves:
1 — Start from a template, vibe-code in any tool.
2 — Deploy through Blaze — our enterprise Vercel.
3 — Blaze owns 100% of compliance and shows you where you stand.

scenes.narration: It starts with templates. We publish starter template repos on GitHub — one per stack — already wired for how we build and ship. Nobody starts from a blank page.

beats.text: It starts with templates.
We publish starter template repos on GitHub — one per stack.
Pre-wired for how we build and ship. No blank page.

scenes.narration: Then everyone goes to one place: Blaze. Think of it as the enterprise version of Vercel — a single front door that takes what you built and deploys it. You don't wire up infrastructure; you hand it to Blaze.

beats.text: One front door: Blaze.
The enterprise Vercel — it takes your app and deploys it.
No infrastructure to wire up. You hand it to Blaze.

Commercial Cloud (Dev / Prod) · GAC Prod.
Advisory Digital Gateway — our hosted app, by country shelf.

scenes.narration: Here is the heart of it. Nothing reaches an environment except through Blaze's compliance layer — and Blaze owns one hundred percent of it. The automated checks: policy, scans, gates. And critically, the manual gates too — every human approval that has to happen, Blaze tracks and orchestrates. Compliance isn't a separate team you chase. It's the path itself.

beats.text: Blaze owns 100% of compliance.
Automated: policy, scans, gates.
Manual gates too — every human approval Blaze tracks and orchestrates.
Nothing reaches an environment except through this path.

beats.text: You always know where you stand.
Blaze shows it in the UI: checks passed, approval pending, what's next.
Including the manual steps. No chasing status.

Deploy through Blaze, our enterprise Vercel, into governed environments: Commercial Cloud, GAC, the Advisory Digital Gateway. And Blaze owns one hundred percent of compliance, manual steps included, telling you exactly where you stand. Build freely. Ship safely.
